description: Convert text to speech using Edge TTS (free, local — requires the optional node-edge-tts package). Returns an audio file path (OGG/Opus when ffmpeg is available, else MP3).

_account.description: Optional. Override identity for THIS call: pass the AgenticMail agent name (e.g. "Fola") to authenticate as that agent. Requires AGENTICMAIL_ACCOUNT_KEYS_JSON to contain a matching key. Omit to use the default identity (AGENTICMAIL_API_KEY).

voice.description: Preset name (guy, jenny, aria, davis, tony, ana, brian, emma, ryan, sonia, william, natasha) or a full Edge voice id.

name: media_tts
